timing: Added after execution began but before the analyst inspected any confirmation learner outcome or scored result; original protocol and forecasts are unchanged. This is not a claim of full pre-outcome preregistration.
reason: User required at least 5 percent superiority over original published tabular difficulty methods before any new original-E1 comparison.
relative_improvement_definition: (baseline_mean_score - oeh_mean_score) / baseline_mean_score, lower score is better
assessment_unit: MDP-cluster mean in the predeclared 42-stochastic-MDP primary panel
numerical_requirement: At least 5 percent lower in both scores than the strongest score-specific eligible comparator; retain original 10-contrast simultaneous one-sided 95 percent lower-bound gate as well.
published_original_requirement: For each claimed published-method win, audit author formula/implementation, exact input access, prediction target, and whether its native output can be scored without modifying the method. Adaptations and oracle-access methods stay in separate tiers. No blanket 'all published methods' claim from a finite search.
e1_policy: Withhold the new 120-MDP E1 comparison until both the 5 percent numerical requirement and an exact, scoped original-method comparison are evidenced; E1 remains descriptive because it was used in development.
